the generation of large chemical spaces of meaningful molecules.

the development of metrics to evaluate generative models and with the use of randomized SMILES to train generative models that generalize better to larger chemical spaces.

the choice of SMILES variant and training set size have a bigger impact on the model performance than the choice of the RNN cell type.

the use of randomized SMILES in molecular generative models is an effective strategy to improve their performance.

training with randomized strings is a good strategy to improve the quality of generative models, especially for small samples.
